title: Our logo (for small use)
slide_intent: Teach designers to select artwork for the size at which it will actually be seen. Details that read at a large scale can lose definition in a compact signature.
strategic_value: Slack can retain a recognizable small signature by specifying a dedicated horizontal version and a separate symbol size range.
demonstration: Two columns label the largest and smallest uses. The horizontal signatures range from about 90 to 50 px wide. The symbol-only examples range from about 20 to 15 px high.
practical_value: Measure the intended width of a small signature or the height of a standalone mark, then compare it with the stated range before choosing the asset.
